title: The King's Hit List, Part 6
description: The King's Hit List, Part 6 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: You feel as if Sir Ving N'Seacressy wants you to go to Townston and talk to the Undercover Operative there.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 7

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: You feel as if Sir Ving N'Seacressy wants you to go to Townston and talk to the Undercover Operative there.

Offer:

If we were actually investigating the supposed strange activity in Shadow's Embrace, we would probably be making some good progress, thanks to your hypothetical help. If that were the case, I might say something like you are doing a good job!

There might have been a message I did, or did not receive, that mentions an undercover operative in Townston that might have a lead on what the heck is happening to the Guild of Shadows.

It might even be possible that someone like yourself could go to Townston and maybe talk to this undercover operative and see what else they may, or may not, have to say. I don't know for sure, but someone might have said something about the operative being near the entrance to Algernon...or not.

Turn-in:

Good day newbie, before you even ask, the bank is over there.

Oh, sorry, I mistook you for one of those helpless new Dungeon Runners running around Townston, always asking where the bank is. This just in newbies, that thing you want to put in your bank is a worthless piece of crap! Haha!

Level range: 45–100
